name: Habits
description: A private habit, training & reflection tracker for Standard Notes: check-off or count habits, with an optional per-habit workout log (distance, time, RPE) that rolls up in a Training view (dated weekly hours & distance, weekly goals). Today / Calendar / Training / Stats / Insights / Journal views: a day-by-day calendar log you can edit from any date, a daily progress ring, streaks, a journal with paragraphs, light formatting and backdating, mood trends, a morning and evening poem on Today (122 public-domain poems with context notes, reflections saved to the Journal), a Weight tab (daily, weekly and monthly averages, year vs year, any period or year, tap to read values, goal line with projected date, editable weigh-ins), a daily check-in (morning weight, with CSV import such as a Lose It! export, and an end-of-day rating), personal experiments with randomised on/off days, a year-in-review recap, a decision journal (predictions with confidence and review dates, scored for calibration in Insights), gamification (XP, levels, badges), a local Insights dashboard, and a note-size health guardrail. All data is stored inside the note and protected by Standard Notes' end-to-end encryption.
